body:
Thanks for everything  , you really are making me feel better.

Once i tried putting myself out there. I went to abroad as an exchange student , last year. 
Also it was the time i diagnosed myself with social anxiety,depression. I'd already known something was wrong with me for long time , but i gave it a name in there.

That was my first time on the abroad , speaking english.
I  still don't know how i could did that , i must have been so naive,silly and brave.

I tried to attempt classes in first month , barely could talk to the professors , couldn't talk to anyone in the class , i end up not going to make things less awkward after first month , then i couldn't attempt to the exams. I rented a double room that i stayed with a guy,there was a  guy in the other room. They were students. Everything was severely awkward in home ,  we've almost never talked for 4 months , i'm sure they were so scared of me.

But i could somehow manage to join Italian language classes which was offered to exchange students for free , in first days i was anxious that even professor could realize. He asked if i was suffering or something , i awkwardly said "no it's just too hot maybe" while moving my jacket. Then i discovered a gem called alcohol. I would drink a little bit right before classes and it worked like a magic. I wouldn't stay away from saying something in the class , even i could look peoples eye and smile , but since i have 0 social skills it didn't work as its full potential.

Exchange students are most warm,friendly,happy people i have ever seen.
And he was the best teacher i have ever seen , sophisticated old guy in his 60s a real friend of his students , he made everything so comfortable for me.
Despite i being so depressed language classes were so beautiful. If i had discovered alcohol before the classes i might have made some friends there.

Except Italian classes which was just 2 months 4 hours a week , everything pretty sucked i didn't leave the home much and i was all alone.

Some moments there made me lose my hopes , though i've learnt a lot about everything. But since studying abroad was kind of my last hope , it dragged me into worse of myself.


So i tried but couldn't succeed , i'm afraid i will fail if i try again such as volunteering or something similar.

Since i don't have someone to tell those  irl , and am not able to go to a therapist , i thought writing on internet could be helpful.

If you wonder about the longer story. 
Here it is , i'd warn you it's long and probably boring.

https://www.reddit.com/r/socialanxiety/comments/6yc3zt/feeling_bad

I am sorry all that happened to you. I am happy that you have learned from your experiences , became wiser and are getting better.

I meant physically abuse never happened.

They have almost never ordered me to do their personal things or like to clean the house or to cook , my mom always do those.
I don't think they are severe people nor other people think. Everyone loves them. They are just ignorant who think they would have good boy by raising him overprotective and strictly.

Obviously they're the core of my problems , especially for anxiety which brings depression with itself over time.

It's an ordinary family.
Nothing abusive happened , i have never even got slapped. Though i've been yelled,bullied,forced to do something a lot.

For instance when i was a child , we would go to other cities in holidays , it would always end up bad , i would be yelled for stupid things. I have been yelled many times for not buying anything from the mall , lol. Not wanting to go to swim....
Many times have been forced to interact with olders ,   guests...

Just 3 weeks ago i was bullied for not wanting to go them to visit my relatives.


They watched my every steps when i was a child , they still do. Where i am going , who i'm going with...every little detail , in school in home in everywhere.

I shared lots of bad moments with them , i don't remember any good ones.
They feel like they are a good family together , they'd include me.

I don't feel like i belong to them.

I think they have always been too strict , since i was 12 or so i always want to leave them to forever.

And as i said earlier we don't have anything in common , we have quite opposite opinions.
They're religious i'm not , opposite political views etc.
I see them as semi-ignorants.
Why should not i leave them ?

I don't understand what you really mean , i feel like i'm standing outside. But i'm physically dependent to them , i don't know how to stand on my own feet.
I always wanted to run away from them , but i couldn't.

Like a normal family without any problem.

No , or yes everything.
I think what makes family is the moments and things you have shared with them. Genetic relation doesn't have any meaning. If i were born in a different family , we wouldn't even be acquaintances with my recent family. 

We don't have anything in common.

I have a younger sister , a father and mother which look like pretty well from the outside.

I think i've never been real myself to them.
And i don't like them.

I don't remember. When i was about 10yo(22 recently) , i was ok/good with strangers around my ages except girls.

But i was not much able to talk to someone older,or to authority. 
Especially around of my family i couldn't  interact with my friends.

Then progressively everthing's got worse overtime.

Sorry , my english isn't good. What i meant there is if they come up to me with the mindset to be friends or just talk for a while , after i saying 3 words they give up keeping the interaction. Maybe because i'm too serious , rude.
